8:55am. Seen well in air above pond near Rhizocore Building mobbed by crows and magpies and photographed. Disappeared towards Bilston over pine trees and not refound by 11am. Uploaded soon. We thought it to be a jay at first with a magpie-like flight style, but with a much shorter tail. Curved long bill and pale orange head with crest. Black and white markings on wings. To dodge crows, it would tuck both wings in and drop with speed before flying straight back upwards. Landed briefly in small Alder by pond before being scared off towards the pines at the back past the building site
